instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium close-up at eye-level with a shallow depth of field. On a warm outdoor patio during the day, the woman in the grey long-sleeve shirt (R1) is on the left, leaning forward and looking at the young woman in the floral dress (R2) with a gentle smile. The young woman (R2) stands on the right, facing left and looking down thoughtfully. The woman (R1) places her right hand affectionately on the young woman's (R2) shoulder, establishing a tender connection. The scene is illuminated by warm, natural daylight, creating a soft and intimate atmosphere.
